originals: 01a14575-680f-7fc2-b9ac-93e0d1dfa769: reuse existing YouTube Google session across app browsers
state: Google session/profile and account-window/fallback popup integration implemented;54 native and295 frontend tests passed. Debug build in progress, actual user authentication acceptance pending.
conflicts: Earlier image-platform-sessions social-login exclusion is superseded by explicit current request.
Earlier physical profile isolation is superseded ONLY for YouTube/Pinterest/Pixiv browser identity. Service authorization, query generations, media and UI state remain isolated.
Sharing a Google browser session is not permission to connect accounts or skip official consent/security screens. Google embedded OAuth policy may still reject a flow; do not spoof or bypass it.
decisions: Reuse exact existing youtube-original-profile through a neutral browser-profile resolver. Do not copy, export, merge, rename or delete cookies/profiles. Preserve old Pinterest/Pixiv directories; a one-time service relogin may be required.

Pinterest account, official fallback and hidden query documents, plus Pixiv holder/account, must use the same profile as YouTube. New-window features preserve opener/environment for official GIS callbacks.

Permit exact verified official provider HTTPS hosts only in owned login windows. Normal search, metadata transport, player and IPC allowlists stay narrow. No foreign host can acquire privileged app commands.

Bound popup count/depth; parent flow owns child lifetime, deny stale/shutdown creation, no downloads and no remote script injection. Close only owned children when parent closes, never unrelated windows.

Pinterest official fallback keeps service-only main navigation while allowing the same owned GIS popup. New searches/detach/failure revoke only their own popup owner atomically; weak current-owner callback avoids a reference cycle.
Keep fresh service-specific authentication proof and original completion URL checks. Google presence is never Pinterest/Pixiv success; security/consent pages remain visible.

Service logout uses that service's official route, never clears shared storage. Google account logout/switch may affect Google/YouTube identity according to official behavior; no claim of absolute logout isolation and no forced player reload.
Existing favorites, saved originals, card rules and session-generation guards unchanged. CHZZK/SOOP profiles and business state unchanged.
Normal development restart allowed only after safe app drain, no forced kill. User performs authentication and account linking. No goal, commit, release or data cleanup.
checks: Exact HTTPS origins, fake subdomains, userinfo/ports, non-web schemes and unrelated platform navigation rejected
Profile resolver retains existing YouTube path and all three provider surfaces use it
Popup opener/environment, bounded ownership, parent close and stale/shutdown checks
Google/Apple security pages cannot trigger service auto-close or login success
Focused native/session/frontend tests and normal debug build
Actual user Google login with retained YouTube session, service return/autoclose/status, native feed and original download remain explicit acceptance gates
